Run familiar tools including `ls`, `cp`, `mv`, `cat`, `sort`, `dd`, and `du` with the Rust-based uutils coreutils. This package replaces the bootstrap’s GNU coreutils.

## Installation

Install explicitly with `dpkg -i --force-conflicts <deb>`. Do not install through Sileo or apt: resolving the conflict removes GNU coreutils before the replacement can be unpacked and can leave the device unable to finish installation. The original GNU binaries are backed up in `usr/libexec/uutils/gnu-backup` for restoration when removing this package.

## Compatibility

Requires iOS 15 or later and a roothide or rootless bootstrap. Choose `iphoneos-arm64e` for roothide or `iphoneos-arm64` for rootless. `stdbuf`, `chroot`, `chcon`, and `runcon` are excluded.

Commands launched by `env`, `nice`, and `nohup` have an extra parent process. Use process-group signals for whole-job control; SIGKILL and SIGSTOP sent only to the parent cannot be forwarded.

[View Source and Installation Instructions](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/coreutils)
